snippet.title: 8-bitBot game trailer v2
snippet.description:
8-bitBot is the game I am working on since July 2025. It is a programming puzzle game where you create very simple programs for up to 3 bots to solve little levels. The steam page can be found here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3959370/8bitBot/

8-bitBot is programmed in C using raylib. 

#raylib #logicgame #puzzlegame #programminggame #programming #solodev #gamedev #gametrailer #indiegame
